verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an ingestion hub where you choose standard connectors by data source and refers to managed connectors, with SQL and Spark APIs as more customizable alternatives (docs-20, docs-107). It also has documented partner setup for dbt as an ETL/ELT tool (docs-10, docs-14, docs-35) and Auto Loader for cloud storage files (docs-1, docs-13). The pack never names which SaaS apps or databases the managed connectors cover, and the only partner tool it evidences is dbt. missing for 10: named SaaS-app and database connectors with setup docs, evidence of a broader partner/ETL tool catalog (e.g., Fivetran-style partners), independent or hands-on corroboration of connector coverage.
